items.name: Readability
items.evidence: It's a simple guard, `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):`, that matches the surrounding style and the comments already there. The intent is clear.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It uses the existing is_cached API in three places with no new bookkeeping. The extra guards in the forward and reverse one-to-one paths repeat the same idiom on purpose.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It adds no exception handling and no magic constants. The guard keeps the old behavior when nothing is cached, and the hidden tests pass (P2P 85/85).

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: It guards with is_cached in RelatedManager.get_prefetch_queryset and does the same in ReverseOneToOneDescriptor (`if not self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj):`). The reverse relation is still set when nothing is cached.
